item.title: First Time In 83 Years: K'taka Introduces 10% Women's Quota In Fire Services
item.description: Karnataka is preparing to welcome its first batch of women firefighters, as the government recently announced a 10% female quota in the State's Fire and Emergency Services Department. For a sector that has been around since 1942, this is a real turning point. The government has also proposed replacing the title “Fireman” with the gender neutral “Firefighter” in all official records and recruitment notifications. item.title: Billy Jean King Did Not Just Change Tennis, She Challenged Sexism
item.description: In 1973, a tennis match caught the world’s attention for reasons much bigger than sport. It was about proving that women athletes deserved to be taken seriously. At that time, many people believed women’s sports were not as important or as exciting as men’s.
